confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on crowdsourced Expatistan and CityCost points, several dated February 2025 or undated, plus a June 2026 Buenos Aires cocktail figure and a July 2026 Argentina-wide cappuccino average used as level checks. Peso figures were converted at about 1,480-1,500 ARS per USD, the rate implied by CityCost's own USD-to-ARS pairs; this is not a verified current rate. Ushuaia's tourist and July high-season premium is only partly captured. The RBA observation is the latest one I could retrieve, dated 2026-03-20, and may be stale. Cocktail is bounded from the ARS 14,900 downtown-club point and the Buenos Aires 2026 figure, with beer as a cross-check. Wine glass is scaled from a Ushuaia bottle price and checked against beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season and were not checked against live listings or booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Food and drink anchors are based on Ushuaia-specific crowdsourced price points, checked against Argentine Patagonian tourist-town levels and Buenos Aires 2026 cocktail prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a remote, high-demand Patagonian gateway in winter season.
